title: New Luxury Custom House by Downtown, Fun Amenities
description:
A modern, stylish luxury experience at this two-year-old custom house just 2 miles from downtown!  Enjoy the large hot tub, 3 decks, gaming area and 6 TVs.  Perfect for a long weekend with 6-8 guests, in a peaceful safe neighborhood blocks from Shelby Park's miles of greenway, golf courses, recreation...and so many popular local restaurants!  Just a 5minute Uber to downtown/Broadway honky tonks.

This is a newer listing with experienced Host over a decades at other properties.  Enjoy Music City!

The space
There are 2 full bathrooms & 2 half bathrooms. 
Two spacious bedrooms with newer queen beds.
One office/room with brand new foldout wide twin.
Another brand new foldout twin in movie room.
Two new large couches in movie room & living room.
The yellow chair folds into a twin bed (good for a kid)
There's one brand new queen air mattress + two twin air mattresses.

Owner's master bedroom and garage area is locked / off limits. There is a totally separate guest apartment with isolated private entrance, who won't have access to your rental areas.

Guest access
Entire house, hot tub, gaming area - minus garage & totally separate guest apartment.

Other things to note
No pets whatsoever ;)
